ttea

T-TEA interactive floor exergame console.

Modules

app

Application configuration package of the T-TEA platform.

controller

Controller classes of the T-TEA platform.

core

Core camera and calibration package of the T-TEA platform.

dao

Data Access Objects (DAOs) of the T-TEA platform.

exception

Exception package for the T-TEA platform.

factory

Factory package for creating and managing application views.

games

Games of the T-TEA console.

log

Application logging support for the T-TEA platform.

main

Main entry point of the T-TEA Qt application.

model

Data models of the T-TEA platform.

service

Service classes of the T-TEA platform.

testrunner

Entry point of uv run tests: runs the test suite headless.

util

Utility classes for the T-TEA platform.

view

Views (Qt windows and dialogs) of the T-TEA platform.

window

Package for window management utilities in the T-TEA platform.
